description: This file defines a custom permission class 'IsOwner' for a Django REST Framework project, used to restrict access to objects based on ownership. It imports permissions base classes from 'rest_framework.permissions' and implements logic to check if the requesting user owns the object.

classes.name: IsOwner
classes.description: Custom Django REST Framework permission class that grants access only to the owner of the object.
